questions.prompt: At steady state, 500 calls average 30 seconds. What answered-call rate sustains them?
questions.explanation: Answered CPS is concurrency divided by average connected duration: 500 / 30.

questions.prompt: Why align generator and server measurements to the same time windows?
options: To compare the same workload interval
To increase the number of calls artificially
questions.explanation: Misaligned windows can compare a ramp on one system with steady state on another.

questions.prompt: A report says every call succeeded, but RTP counters are zero. What is the correct response?
options: Inspect whether success checked signalling only
Accept the headline without further checks
Raise the worker limit without checking media
questions.explanation: A signalling success does not prove media flowed. Validate the report’s success definition against per-call media evidence.
